title: fix: install centaur tool CLI shims in sandbox
body:
## Summary
- add install-tool-shims to the sandbox image
- run shim installation from sandbox entrypoint for TOOL_DIRS / TOOLS_PATH / TOOLS_OVERLAY_PATH
- support --copy-tools so api-rs tools-bootstrap publishes nested tool packages into /app/tools

Amp thread: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019ef5fb-672e-718d-bdee-a5d8fce97664

## Verification
- uv run --with pytest pytest services/sandbox/test_install_tool_shims.py -q
- uv run --with ruff ruff check services/sandbox/install_tool_shims.py services/sandbox/test_install_tool_shims.py
- just build-one sandbox
- docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tools:/app/tools:ro" -e TOOL_DIRS=/app/tools --entrypoint /entrypoint.sh centaur-agent:latest bash -lc 'centaur-tools list | head; echo count:$(centaur-tools json | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)))")'\n\n## Deployed diagnosis\nLive asbx pods run centaur-agent:main-sha-412d4fc. api-rs invokes install-tool-shims --copy-tools from tools-bootstrap, but that deployed script ignores --copy-tools, publishes no packages to /app/tools, and centaur-tools list is empty.
